description: Verify an artifact produced by an AI agent before accepting or paying for it. Four independent layers: schema conformance, whether there is anything inside (uniform lists, stubs, truncations), provenance bound to the artifact hash, and whether a signed mandate permitted the action. Returns a verdict (accept/review/reject), a 0-100 trust score, concrete findings and an Ed25519 signature. Rule-based, no LLM: the same artifact always yields the same result. Use before accepting work from another agent and before payment.

artifact.description: The agent artifact: object, array or string.

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema the artifact must satisfy.

source.description: Where the artifact came from, recorded in the attestation.

name: verify_artifact
title: Verify an AI agent artifact
